page.layout: One title page, centred. Printed lines in capitals and roman, with italic lines in the middle. No running head, page number or catchword.

main_text.l: 1. Primus continet testimonia & exempla Sacræ Scripturæ utriusq; testamenti.
2. Secundus Ecclesiæ Primitiæ innocentiam,& erga Principes obedientia,sub decem gravissimis persecutionib9.
3. Tertius Orthodoxorum fidelitatem in Hæreticos, & nefarios Imp. ab Imperio Constantini Magni usque ad exitum Phocæ,
Authore Georgio Hakewill, Sacræ Theologiæ Doctore è Coll. Exoniensi in Academia Oxon.

page.notes: The old-style numerals in "6io." (Domini 610) and "1612" are read with some doubt; the first is marked [?]. Long s is printed as f-like in places ("Exoniensi", "persecutionib9") and is set as plain s. u/v spelling is normalised (SCUTUM, REGIUM, ADVERSUS, usque, divisus, utriusq;). The superscript 9 in "persecutionib9" is kept as printed. The "Imp." line has a comma-like mark after it, which is treated as a printing mark and left out.
